title.zh-Hans: Noto Sans TC（繁体中文字体）

description.en: Draws traditional Chinese text in its own character forms where the system has no font for it (Linux without Noto Sans CJK, subtitles on iPhone). Downloaded by itself when needed.
description.zh-Hans: 系统里没有繁体中文字体时（没装 Noto Sans CJK 的 Linux、iPhone 上的字幕），用它按繁体中文字形显示。需要时自动下载。
